rules.name: Store complete sequence records
rules.enforcement: Store ID, number, duration, purpose, continuity source, references, beginning/middle/ending, START/MID/END states, camera, lighting, sound, dialogue, negative rules, attempts, review, output, and approved END state.

rules.name: Sequence duration is a project setting
rules.enforcement: Thirty seconds is a supported default, not a hidden or exclusive duration.

rules.name: Sequences progress beginning to middle to ending
rules.enforcement: Beginning establishes inherited state, middle advances action or information, and ending lands on a deliberate continuity handoff.

rules.name: Prompt exact entity counts
rules.enforcement: Character, creature, animal, and relevant background counts are explicit when duplication risk exists.

rules.name: Actions obey physical logic
rules.enforcement: Respect distance, direction, possession, environment, ability, damage, injury, and animal or vehicle movement; no unexplained teleportation.

rules.name: Regenerate the smallest failed scope
rules.enforcement: Classify failures and repair the smallest appropriate shot, region, transition, frame, reference, prompt, or sequence scope.

rules.name: Invalidate downstream artifacts
rules.enforcement: When an approved upstream state changes, mark dependent prompts, frames, results, and continuity states stale.
